architectural_fidelity.reason: Room architecture is preserved: same door position and white finish, same window location with blinds on right wall, same ceiling height, same camera angle and viewpoint, wall colors transformed but room structure intact

furniture_removal.reason: All original furniture completely removed with no ghost outlines, TV mount gone, gaming chair eliminated, media console cleared, carpet area clean with no remnants

style_commitment.reason: Unmistakable Art Deco commitment: large-scale white marble feature walls with gray veining, geometric brass/gold accents on fireplace base, curved teal velvet seating, metallic gold table lamp, luxe materials throughout—this is emphatically NOT generic neutral staging

editorial_density.reason: Present but minimal: fireplace as focal point, one sculptural lamp, curved sofa, side tables visible in foreground, carpet texture—lacks the layered textiles (throws, multiple pillows), wall art, plants, and styling vignettes expected at Architectural Digest level

photorealism.reason: Strong photorealism: coherent ambient and fireplace lighting with realistic glow, proper marble material rendering with convincing veining and reflection, accurate shadows, brass/gold finishes look authentic, no CGI plasticity

designer_preference_reason: Cova delivers a distinctive, luxury Art Deco vision with high-impact materials that would excite clients, whereas Collov's generic modern staging lacks personality despite technical competence
what_cova_does_better: Bold, unmistakable style commitment with Art Deco language
Luxurious material palette: marble walls, brass accents, velvet upholstery
Dramatic focal point with custom fireplace surround
Distinctive design personality that would differentiate a listing
what_collov_does_better: More complete editorial styling with layered textiles and accessories
Greater density of decorative elements (wall art, plants, throw pillows)
More lived-in warmth through styling details
Multiple light sources and vignettes throughout
specific_fixes_if_failing: Add large-scale Art Deco wall art or geometric mirror above fireplace
Layer in 3-4 throw pillows with geometric Art Deco patterns on sofa
Include tall sculptural plant or palm in corner
Add decorative objects on side table surfaces
Consider additional table lamp or floor lamp for lighting variety
